_readme: Curated Boston services for the prototype. Phone numbers and links were copied from each official website on 2026-10-21. Leya re-confirms each entry and updates last_verified to the date she checked. An empty phone means it was not confirmed, so the agent shows the website and 'call to confirm'. Only these services can appear in a plan.

services.name: FriendshipWorks Medical Escort
services.how_to_use: A trained volunteer goes with you to the appointment and helps you get home. Call well ahead to book.

services.name: Age Strong Shuttle (medical appointment rides)
services.how_to_use: Free rides to medical appointments in Boston for older adults. Call ahead to book. Ask if a driver can wait for you after a procedure.

services.name: City of Boston Age Strong Commission (Boston's Council on Aging)
services.how_to_use: Boston's Council on Aging. They can connect you with rides, meals, and help at home.

services.name: MBTA The RIDE (door-to-door rides)
services.waitlist_note: You must apply and be approved before your first ride. Apply weeks ahead.
services.how_to_use: Shared door-to-door rides for people who cannot use buses or trains. Low fare per trip.

services.name: Ethos (elder services)
services.how_to_use: Meals and help at home. Serves Jamaica Plain, Roslindale, West Roxbury, Hyde Park, and Mattapan. Some services are free; others use a sliding scale.

services.name: Eversource medical protection help
services.how_to_use: If you use medical equipment that needs power, ask your electric company to note it on your account. This can protect you from shutoff and help them reach you in an outage.

services.name: MSPCA-Angell
services.how_to_use: An animal hospital and shelter. Call to ask if they offer short-term care or can refer you to someone who does. Costs vary.

services.name: Animal Rescue League of Boston
services.how_to_use: Call to ask about help with pet care while you are in the hospital, or for a referral. Costs vary.

services.name: CaringBridge
services.how_to_use: A free, donor-supported nonprofit where you make a private site to share health updates with family and friends, and use its Planner so people can sign up to help with rides, meals, errands, and pet care.
